history.summary: Marta meets Lukas, who takes her to the station free of charge. She promises to tell him about her journey tomorrow.
history.cliffhanger: At the station, Marta is about to discover that her ticket is missing.

scenes.speaker: marta

scenes.fa: صبح بخیر! به ایستگاه قطار می‌روید؟
scenes.scene: Marta stands beside the taxi and politely asks Lukas a question; medium two shot.

scenes.fa: بله، البته. لطفاً سوار شوید.

scenes.fa: واقعاً؟ این خیلی مهربانانه است.

scenes.motion: Marta speaks in delighted surprise, smiles and briefly lifts her free hand to her chest.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Ich helfe Ihnen mit der Tasche.
scenes.fa: در برداشتن کیف کمکتان می‌کنم.

scenes.motion: Lukas speaks, gently lifts the handbag and moves it towards the back seat.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Vielen Dank. Mein Zug fährt um zwölf Uhr.
scenes.fa: خیلی ممنون. قطار من ساعت دوازده حرکت می‌کند.
scenes.scene: Marta is seated comfortably in the rear of the taxi, looking towards Lukas at the driver's door.
scenes.motion: Marta speaks, settles into the seat and looks towards the driver with a grateful smile.

scenes.speaker: lukas

scenes.fa: نگران نباشید. به‌موقع می‌رسیم.

scenes.motion: Lukas speaks reassuringly, looks ahead and gently turns the steering wheel as the street moves outside.

scenes.fa: ایستگاه قطار همین جلو است.

history.summary: Lukas realizes Marta left her train ticket on the taxi backseat. He rushes into the busy station just in time to hand it to her before her train departs, but a new oversight soon appears.
history.cliffhanger: Back in his taxi after the train departs, Lukas discovers Marta's heavy bunch of house keys lying under the passenger seat.

scenes.motion: Lukas pushes the taxi door shut with his hip and sets off into a brisk jog toward the station doors.

scenes.motion: Lukas jogs through the crowd, speaking reassuringly into his phone as he holds the ticket in front of him.

scenes.fa: شما را کنار ساعت بزرگ می‌بینم!

history.summary: At the supermarket entrance, two flatmates realize their reusable bag is missing. They agree to buy only essentials and calmly check what they have at home, what they need and what they will cook for dinner before going inside.
history.cliffhanger: Next time they will put the reusable shopping bag by the door before leaving home.
history.visual_hook: Marta checks her personal handbag at the supermarket entrance and realizes she left the reusable shopping bag at home.
history.everyday_problem: The shopping bag is missing, so the flatmates agree on a small practical grocery list before entering the store.
history.practical_resolution: They choose essentials, confirm the quantities they need for dinner and remember to bring the reusable bag next time.

history.summary: Marta and Lukas choose tomatoes, spaghetti and an intact egg carton at the supermarket. They check a cracked egg and safely pack the replacement. The oat-milk purchase and checkout conversation continue in the next episode.
history.cliffhanger: Next, they still need oat milk before walking to the checkout; continue the two deferred scenes first.

history.summary: A practical A1/A2 German lesson: two flatmates set a table for two. Every short instruction or response visibly demonstrates plates, forks, knives, drinking glasses or napkins in the same dining room.
history.cliffhanger: With the table ready, they can serve dinner. The unshown supermarket steps remain saved for a later episode.
history.visual_hook: Marta holds two dinner plates clearly in front of the dining table and introduces the practical task immediately.
history.everyday_problem: The flatmates need to arrange two complete place settings with utensils and glasses in the correct positions.
history.practical_resolution: The plates, forks, knives, glasses and napkins are physically placed to complete a usable table setting.

reference.reviewed: Downloaded public videos; examined frame sequences and their German timed captions.
reference.adaptation: Original adult flatmate characters and new table-setting dialogue. Borrow the teaching method: name an object, show it clearly, demonstrate the matching physical action.

history.summary: At the railway platform, Marta is excited to board a sleek white ICE train with her monthly ticket. Lukas clarifies that the ticket is valid for regional trains rather than high-speed services, prompting Marta to spot their red Regionalbahn on the opposite track and board it herself.
history.cliffhanger: Next time, Marta learns what to do when a train delay changes their connection.
history.visual_hook: Marta points her glowing smartphone ticket eagerly at an incoming high-speed white ICE train on track one.
history.everyday_problem: Marta assumes her regional transit ticket is valid on all German trains, including fast ICE express services.
history.practical_resolution: Marta learns the practical distinction between Regionalbahn and ICE, checks the platform display, and boards the correct regional train.
history.marta_goal: Take the correct train home using her monthly transit ticket.
history.marta_decision: Marta turns away from the fast ICE train, identifies the red Regionalbahn on track two, and opens the carriage door herself.
history.visual_payoff: Marta presses the illuminated green door button on the red Regionalbahn with a confident smile, happily claiming the regional train is cozier anyway.

plan.summary: A delayed regional train gives Marta time to unpack breakfast on the platform. A runaway bread roll and an unexpectedly arriving train turn a quiet break into a scramble; she catches her breakfast and learns zum Mitnehmen.
plan.cliffhanger: Next time, Marta brings her takeaway breakfast home and faces the apartment building recycling bins.
plan.visual_hook: Marta checks a delayed train on her phone while her uncovered coffee steams beside her; she immediately decides to eat breakfast.
plan.everyday_problem: A newcomer unpacks breakfast while waiting for a delayed train, then must quickly pack her food when the train arrives.
plan.practical_resolution: Marta catches her bread roll, puts the lid on her coffee and safely takes her breakfast aboard; zum Mitnehmen is demonstrated with real props.
plan.marta_goal: Use the unexpected station wait to eat breakfast without losing her train or food.
plan.marta_decision: Marta rescues the sliding bread roll herself, packs the food and secures the coffee lid before boarding.
plan.visual_payoff: Marta proudly treats the rescued bread bag as another passenger, then enjoys her takeaway breakfast safely seated.
